in_english.name: Reeham
in_english.meaning: Love, joy, comfort, love, joy, comfort, love, joy, comfort
in_english.long_meaning: Reeham: Derived from Arabic root 'Ra' (رضي) meaning love, joy, and comfort. In Islamic tradition, Reeham represents the love and devotion between Prophet Muhammad and his wife Khadija. It symbolizes the joy and comfort that comes from a loving relationship. In Arabic, Reeham is also associated with the concept of 'Rahma' (رَحْمَة), which means mercy and compassion. As a given name, Reeham is often bestowed upon girls, signifying their potential to bring joy and comfort to those around them.

In the Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is described as a mercy to all creation, and the name Reeham can remind us of the importance of being kind, compassionate, and caring towards others. It can also serve as a reminder to be a source of comfort and peace in our interactions and relationships. Overall, the name Reeham encapsulates the Islamic values of compassion, beauty, and love.
